transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
After I do it, I just sit there looking at all the empty containers and feel disgusted with myself. Like I’m not the steady, in-control man I’ve always tried to be.
When you say “do it,” what exactly are you doing?

I mean I eat way more than I planned. I’ll heat up what I tell myself is one bowl of pozole, then I’ve finished the whole pot, had a couple tamales, chips, whatever leftovers are there. It’s like I’m feeding a whole crew, not just myself.
When this happens, do you feel unable to stop eating once you’ve started?
Yeah. Once I start, it’s like the discipline I had on the road just shuts off. I’m telling myself, “Magin, put the fork down,” but my hand keeps going back for more anyway.
After these eating episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit?
No, I don’t make myself throw up afterward.
Do these eating episodes upset you a lot?

Yeah, a lot. Afterward I look at all the empty containers and just feel disgusted with myself. I’ve always tried to be a steady, in-control man, and then I’m sitting there wondering why I couldn’t stop.
When this happens, do you eat an unusually large amount of food in a short period of time?

Yeah. I’ll think I’m just having one bowl of pozole, then I look up and I’ve finished the whole pot, plus a couple tamales, chips, whatever leftovers are around. It’s like I’m feeding a whole crew, not just myself.
After one of these episodes, do you intentionally skip meals or go a long time without eating to make up for it?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid close attention to whether I skip meals afterward.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed feeling depressed most of the day.
After one of these episodes, do you ever exercise a lot to make up for the eating?
I’m not sure, doctor. I haven’t really paid attention to whether I exercise more after it.
After one of these eating episodes, do you intentionally fast or go without eating for a long time to make up for it?
I don’t know, honestly. I haven’t really kept track of whether I go without eating afterward on purpose.
After these episodes, do you try to compensate for the eating in any way?
I’m not really sure what you mean by compensate. I haven’t noticed myself doing anything specific afterward.
During these eating episodes, do you feel like you can’t stop yourself once you’ve started?
Yeah. Once I start, it’s like my discipline just shuts off. Even when I’m telling myself, “Magin, put the fork down,” I keep reaching for more.
When these episodes happen, do you feel unable to stop eating even when you want to?
Yeah. I want to stop, but once I’ve started it’s like my discipline just disappears. I’ll be telling myself to put the fork down, and I still keep going back for more.
During these eating episodes, do you feel unable to stop eating once you’ve started?
Yeah. It’s like the discipline I have out on the road just shuts off. I’m telling myself, “Magin, put the fork down,” but my hand just keeps going back for more.
About how often do these eating episodes happen?
Since I’ve been home with my back injury, it’s been several nights most weeks. I can’t think of a week in the last three months where it didn’t happen at least once.
